source.label: mtg-jp.com coverage, 2022 Asia Eternal Weekend Vintage トップ８デッキリスト

notes.text: Held inside Players Convention Aichi 2022, organized by BIG MAGIC. mtg-jp prints card names in Japanese (Power, duals and other old cards in English); `name` is the English name, checked against Scryfall and mtg-jp's own English export, and `printed_as` the Japanese as printed. Seven lists match mtgtop8's copy of the Melee lists card for card.

Placings 1st-8th are mtg-jp's. mtgtop8's Top 8 is wrong: it ranks Chris Schiber 1st and Youhei Tsumori 2nd, puts the champion Takakuwa in 3-4, and leaves out Gen Shinohara. The final report spells the runner-up "Chris Schiver". mtg-jp gives no archetypes; they are mtgtop8's.
Seeds are the standings after the last Swiss round (Round 7) on the Melee page; they match the quarterfinal pairings (1v8, 2v7, 3v6, 4v5).
